rationale.headline: Platform-sized sponsor with 9 deals in 3 years, 4 prior Healthcare Services deals and zero withdrawals
rationale.acquirer_overview: Nordic Capital is a financial sponsor with 24 deals in 2016-2024, 9 of them in the last 3 years. Most deals are in Physician Groups (10) and Healthcare Services (4), with a size sweet spot of $35.0-302.1M (IQR). It most often buys from Private and PE-Backed sellers (9 each of 24), and its most common financing is All Cash (7 of 24). Its history shows a bias toward physician-led and dental assets, with a median target margin of 12.7% and median growth of 10.3%.
rationale.strategic_fit_thesis: Project Atlas is a platform for Nordic Capital: size_role is platform, inside its interquartile range $35.0-302.1M. Its own platform-labelled deals are smaller (3 deals, median $26.4M), and the dataset's deal_type labels are noisy, so we rely on the size band rather than the label. For example, [MA-2022-0103], a $222.1M Dental deal at 21.4% margin, is tagged Bolt-on Acquisition yet also carries Platform Build. The closest competitor is New Mountain Capital. The sharpest difference is sector depth: Nordic has 4 deals in Healthcare Services against 1 for New Mountain. Nordic also has 9 deals in the last 3 years against 5, and 0 withdrawn or terminated deals against 4. Nordic has 7 closed deals in the size band, 2 of them recent, so it can deploy at this size.

precedent_activity.why_relevant: Closest precedent: $222.1M Dental deal, 21.4% margin, 11.6x EV/EBITDA, closed 2022, usable as comp and close to the target's margin and size.
Most recent in-band-style deal: $76.0M Physician Groups recapitalization at 15.9x with 1 bidder, showing pace in 2024.
$301.0M Physician Groups recapitalization at 14.0x, top of its size range, closed with 2 bidders.
$388.8M leveraged buyout at 13.4x on a 7.4% margin target, shows willingness to go above the target's size.

rationale.valuation_context: Nordic's median of 13.8x across 6 comparable closed control deals (interquartile 13.4-14.7x) is in line with its Financial Sponsor peers at 13.5x, a 0.3 turn gap. Its highest-margin precedent, [MA-2022-0103] at 21.4%, cleared at 11.6x, while [MA-2024-0431] at a 16.8% margin went at 15.9x. Margin alone therefore does not set its price. Nordic's median target margin of 12.7% sits well below Atlas's 21.5%, so expect it to push on margin-adjusted value.

risk_flags.detail: Two stale pending or rumored deals, [MA-2020-0156] and [MA-2020-0291], with the largest withdrawn or pending at $232.9M, so announced intent has not always converted to closings.
Median target margin of 12.7% against Atlas's 21.5%; Nordic's high-margin precedent [MA-2022-0103] cleared at 11.6x, so its pricing may not reward margin.
Only 2 relevant closed deals out of 24 and 4 in the target sector; its largest closed deal of $1304.4M is far above Atlas, so sector evidence at this size is thin.

conviction.rationale: Held at the suggested High: 7 closed adjacent-sector deals in the size band, 2 in the last 3 years, 4 prior Healthcare Services deals, and no withdrawn deals. Thin relevance (2 relevant closed deals) is the main caveat.
